flows.name: Select and open
steps: Render accepted list projection
Single click/keyboard navigation changes active/selected state only
Double-click or Enter requests default open destination
Open workbench/detail without mutating domain state
Return restores surviving filters/selection/scroll/focus or deterministic fallback

flows.name: Edit and save
steps: Create UI working copy from accepted revision token
Track dirty fields/sections separately from persistent domain Draft
Validate locally without claiming authority
Submit explicit command with base revision and required scope
Server/domain revalidates and commits or rejects
On success refresh accepted revision/projection; on failure preserve safe working input and conflict/error details

flows.name: Stale conflict
steps: Detect base revision mismatch
Load current accepted facts and relationships
Present current vs working-copy differences plus safely reapplicable changes
Operator reviews disposition
Issue a new command against the current revision
Never last-write-wins identity/evidence/lifecycle truth

flows.name: Relationship consolidation
steps: Select existing relationship target/candidate
Build reviewed context/impact preview from authoritative identities
Show incoming context, retained relationships, conflicts and consequences
Operator accepts one governed relationship command
Owning domain revalidates and commits
Refresh derived workbench context without copying/merging entity identities

flows.name: Deliberate hold
steps: Show exact action/consequence label
Start monotonic three-second hold on pointer/touch/keyboard activation
Expose visible and semantic progress
Cancel/reset on release, activation loss, route/target/dependency change or scroll-classified movement
At completion issue at most one command request
Owning domain freshly revalidates before commit

flows.name: Bulk action
steps: Collect explicit multi-selection membership
Ask owning domain for preflight partition
Render eligible/incompatible/stale/missing-input/individual-review groups
Show material impact/preservation
Confirm according to consequence tier
Execute governing all-or-nothing or per-target contract
Render batch and independently addressable per-target results

flows.name: Responsive workbench reflow
steps: Observe available container/viewport space
Change layout composition only
Preserve active record/tab/pane, filters, selection, scroll, working copy and Communication state
Retain all material warnings/actions/evidence through panes/drawers/stacks/overflow
Restore equivalent keyboard/touch/pointer access

workbench_composition: SR workbench: Overview, Devices, Spare Parts, RFCs, Tasks, Notes
RFC workbench: Overview, Service Requests and Devices, Related RFCs, Tasks, Notes
wide workbenches preserve working + communication/evidence panes
narrow workbenches preserve both sides through switchable composition rather than removing evidence
